result_text: Both tooltips now HTML-escape the repository name before it goes into the page. A name like `acme "shop"` shows up as that exact text in the hover. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests and didn't render a report with an HTML-containing name. The changes are in `LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, under `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`: - **Language block tooltip (`addLangInfo`):** the name is escaped, so it reads `acme "shop" (5,000 LOC)`. This method also builds the test and other code variants. - **Size distribution table tooltip:** the name is escaped, so it reads `acme "shop" 5000`. - **Import:** I added `StringEscapeUtils` from commons-lang3, using `escapeHtml4`. Counts, lines of code, order and layout are unchanged. `StringEscapeUtils` in lang3 may be marked deprecated, so the build could show a warning.
